fields.description: Weekly issue containing editorials and local commentary on Miami’s civic development and need for cooperation; U.S. Prohibition enforcement and the Christianson case prompting an apology to Great Britain and new limits on rum-chasers near the Bahamas; downtown traffic problems including double parking; municipal spending/publicity satire involving Mayor Sewell; discussion of high milk prices, dairy regulation, and pasteurization across Dade County municipalities; Coral Gables commission politics and appointment of Alfred K. Simmons; proposals for naming the new Dade County courthouse/administration building; notes on Biscayne Boulevard “islands,” curb market expansion for locally raised meat, and warnings about insecticide packaging; includes society/gossip columns, entertainment listings, and extensive advertising.
